conditions.pushTake: D only: on a zero-point ordinary hand placement, the rightmost row card becomes the replacement hand card; no random hand draw. Wild without a score discards the rightmost card as before. D has nine insertion gaps, excluding far-right; A/B/C keep all original gaps.
conditions.lookahead: Four immediate candidates; one sampled unknown refill; one-ply opponent reply and retained-hand opportunity. Never reads the real deck or hidden opponent hands.
conditions.fairness: Same seeds, initial hand stream, opening-board prefix, draw-deck stream and rotated strategy seats across modes. Actual draws diverge when decisions or row lengths differ.
conditions.distinctOptions: Deduplicated by resulting collapsed row, score, played color and resources used. Raw scoring moves include duplicate hand-card/position choices.
conditions.impact: Swap: same card/position without Swap. Wild: best available normal placement. Descriptive counterfactual, not a randomized causal estimate.
conditions.duration: Moves only; simulated compute time is not human play duration.
